info.name: Livestock ERP Farm Management Final
info.description: Final farm backend workflows: animal/equipment receiving; navigation; batch/individual/group feeding; health; weight; medication; mortality; corrections; histories; plans; summaries; alerts; investigations; follow-ups. Run folders in order after DemoFarmsSeeder. Variables are automatically captured by discovery and workflow responses. Requires farms.view/manage, purchasing create/view/confirm, setup discovery and inventory view permissions. Login uses the existing demo credentials; use your environment credentials when different. Each login starts unique RFID/batch/serial identities. Sales, transfer and reproduction histories display source ledger activity supplied by those modules; this collection does not implement their transactions. Attachments are stored as references; file uploads remain the separate application upload contract. Quantity equipment explicitly uses metadata.tracking_mode=quantity; serialized items require units. Medicine dosage and planned feed use configured stock UOMs. Aggregate quantities across different UOMs should be compared using the item/UOM breakdowns. Internal manager/veterinarian notifications are available through farms/notifications. Default login is the seeded superadmin account because the regular admin role only has farms.view.
